plugin.name: YouTubeMusic
plugin.title: YouTube Music
plugin.desc: Browse, search, and stream YouTube Music to your Squeezebox players.
plugin.changes: Fixes track starts having become a few seconds slower in 1.5.1.6-1.5.1.8: the experimental faster stream path is switched off again (YouTube rejects its direct downloads), so tracks start the same way they did before. Previously: a background prefetch no longer makes a track you're actually starting wait behind it for its stream link. Previously: fixes My Library and other personal playlists getting capped at around 100 tracks. Also: Artists and Albums are sorted alphabetically (albums by artist, then title), and all followed artists are listed, not just the first 500; fixes the server running out of memory on small machines when two tracks start at once; real section names in New Releases; new icon; "Go to artist" / "Go to album" in every track's menu; tracks no longer stop early when a download is cut off; Podcasts menu hidden. Based on upstream 1.5.1, plus download priority within 2 downloads.
plugin.creator: schmij97, NikolajChristensen
